summary: A resident sues less than a day after a bond vote, saying voters should have been asked.
realLife: The morning after a council approved bonds for a new baseball stadium, a resident sued the mayor, members and two clerk staff. The suit said voters were owed a referendum and claimed breaches of the state constitution, the city charter and speech rights. City hall called it meritless and said it could cost residents millions. A league deadline made time short and the city said it would keep the project moving.
